stories.title: Wall Street soars on Huang's return to Nvidia, Treasury yields rise
stories.summary: US stocks rebounded sharply on Monday after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive following pressure from President Donald Trump, reversing part of last week’s tech-led market rout. Nvidia jumped 31%, helping the Nasdaq 100 rise 6.5% and the S&P 500 4.7%, while Treasury yields and the dollar also climbed as investors reassessed both AI-sector sentiment and the Federal Reserve outlook.

stories.title: RBI approves SBI Mutual Fund to acquire up to 9.99% stake in South Indian Bank
stories.summary: SBI Mutual Fund received approval from the RBI to acquire a 9.99 percent stake in South Indian Bank. This approval was communicated to the bank on November 23 and is subject to regulatory compliance. South Indian Bank stated that the approval follows the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 and other applicable guidelines. The lender also reported a 21 percent year-on-year increase in net profit for the second quarter.

stories.title: Investors mint Rs 34.61 lakh cr in November as markets rally nearly 11%
stories.summary: In a remarkable surge this month, Indian equity markets have observed a substantial upswing, with the BSE Sensex climbing nearly 11 percent. This rally was largely propelled by foreign institutional investors, who contributed record-setting inflows exceeding Rs 1 lakh crore. Motivated by lower crude oil prices and impressive Q2 earnings, investor optimism soared, although a recent profit booking saw a minor dip of…

stories.title: Gold Rebounds as Huang’s Return to Nvidia Revives Risk Appetite
stories.summary: Gold extended its rebound in a broad risk-on rally triggered by the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as chief executive officer of Nvidia Corp.

stories.title: Sanofi strikes $41 billion deal to acquire US drugmaker Insmed
stories.summary: Sanofi announced plans to acquire US drugmaker Insmed for $41 billion, which equates to $175 per share. This acquisition represents a premium of approximately 17.5% over Insmed's last closing share price. Sanofi expects the transaction to be accretive to its earnings per share by the end of 2028. The deal is anticipated to close in the first half of 2027.

stories.title: Bernstein upgrades Nvidia stock to outperform as Jensen Huang returns
stories.summary: News of Huang's removal had wiped more than $1 trillion off Nvidia this month, with the shares plunging as much as 14 per cent in a single session.

stories.title: Stock market open today or not? BSE, NSE closed on 24 Nov for Guru Nanak Jayanti? Check holiday calendar
stories.summary: Indian equity markets will close on 24 November for Guru Nanak Jayanti. MCX will pause morning trading and reopen from 5 pm to 11:30 pm, while NCDEX remains closed all day. Christmas is the final scheduled market holiday of 2026.

stories.title: A 50 bps jumbo rate hike can lead to financial stability concerns, hurt growth: Report
stories.summary: SBI economists have lowered their rate hike expectations for the upcoming RBI policy review. They now anticipate a 0.25 per cent increase rather than the previously expected 0.50 per cent. This adjustment stems from concerns regarding financial stability and potential impacts on economic growth. The RBI's monetary policy committee is scheduled to meet from December 2 to December 4.

stories.title: Investors become richer by ₹34.61 trillion as Sensex surges in November
stories.summary: Equity markets have rallied sharply this month, with the BSE Sensex climbing nearly 11 per cent, making equity investors richer by Rs 34.61 lakh crore amid strong foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, better-than-expected Q2 earnings and a global sell-off in AI-linked stocks. The 30-share BSE benchmark Sensex jumped 7,976.46 points, or 10.71 per cent till November 23. Following the bullish trend in equities…

stories.title: Nasdaq Jumped 6.5% On Monday, Now Futures Are Down. Here's What Indian Investors Should Watch
stories.summary: Wall Street's sharp rebound has lost some steam, with Nasdaq 100 futures down nearly 2%. AI valuations, US inflation data and Fed rate expectations remain key triggers for global markets.

stories.title: 31.5% surge in Nvidia share adds $34 billion to Jensen Huang's wealth in a day; what's his net worth now?
stories.summary: Nvidia’s board reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO, president and board member, triggering a 31.5% share-price surge and adding $33.7 billion to his fortune. The rally lifted other AI-related stocks and the Nasdaq, though Nvidia shares remain below their record high and down for the year.

stories.title: India's economic activity growth hits four-year high of 9% in October: Jefferies
stories.summary: India's economic activity growth hit a four-year high of 9% year-on-year in October. The increase was largely attributed to strong industrial activity and a delayed festive season. However, rural demand indicators remained weak due to a subdued monsoon. While bank credit growth reached a nearly 12-year high, inflationary pressures intensified simultaneously. Overall, the report highlights a mixed outlook for future…

stories.title: HDFC Bank, Reliance Industries among 10 stocks with highest DII holding in Q2. See full list
stories.summary: With the rise in the share of MFs and also an overall net investment of Rs 1.69 lakh crore during the quarter, the share of Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) as a whole increased to an all-time high of 19.31% as on September 30, 2026, up from 19.16% as on June 30, 2026. Here are 10 stocks with the highest DII holding in the September quarter.

stories.title: IIFCL IPO: Govt plans to sell part of its stake, company to issue fresh shares
stories.summary: The government aims to partially divest its shareholding in India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd through an initial public offering. The IPO is expected to occur by the end of the current fiscal year, according to an official statement. IIFCL will issue fresh shares to raise capital alongside the government stake sale. The proceeds from the stake sale will contribute to the government's disinvestment revenue.

stories.title: Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia as CEO: How Donald Trump helped engineer the return of a ‘national treasure’
stories.summary: Nvidia’s board unanimously reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO less than two weeks after his resignation amid allegations of extramarital affairs. President Donald Trump said he had intervened with the board, which concluded Huang’s return posed no national security risk.

stories.title: Audi India to hike vehicle prices by up to 2% from January 1
stories.summary: Audi India has announced a price increase for its models effective January 1, 2027, due to rising costs. This adjustment is the second price revision in 2026, following a similar increase in April. The price hike will apply to all models in its portfolio in India, which includes luxury sedans and SUVs. Audi aims to maintain the sustainability of its business while providing a reliable ownership experience.

stories.title: Adani Group planning $120 bn in capex over next 5-6 years: Jefferies
stories.summary: Adani Group plans to invest more than USD 120 billion over the next five to six years across infrastructure, energy and data centres while seeking to keep net debt below 3.5 times earnings (EBITDA), according to a Jefferies research note on the group's annual conference. The group is leaning on its financial record as it expands in power, ports, transmission and data centres. At its annual investor conference, the…

stories.title: Adani signs 3-year copper supply deal with Attero: Report
stories.summary: Adani has entered a three-year agreement with Attero worth about $1 billion for copper anode supply. This collaboration aims to decrease the smelter's reliance on copper imports by approximately 5%. The deal, undisclosed until recently, supports the expansion of the Kutch Copper facility in Gujarat. Attero will produce copper anode by recycling metals from electronic waste and batteries.

stories.title: Tata Sons wins ITAT backing for ₹1,498 crore interest deduction on group investments
stories.summary: The ITAT ruled that Tata Sons may deduct interest on loans used to invest in group companies, subject to limits for expenses linked to tax-exempt income. It said the company’s activities extend beyond passively earning dividends and that its business purpose must be considered.

stories.title: Poonawalla Fincorp share price: After 25% jump in 1 month, JM Financial sees 21% further upside, raises target
stories.summary: JM Financial reiterated its Buy rating on Poonawalla Fincorp and raised its 12-month price target to ₹625 from ₹550, citing growth in secured lending, improving margins and lower expected credit costs. It forecasts rising profits and returns through FY29.

stories.title: FSSAI prohibited sale of only one Goa batch, no stocks in market: Bisleri
stories.summary: Bisleri International confirmed that the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India prohibited one batch of its water. This prohibition affects batch GO 270, manufactured in September 2025 at its Goa plant. Subsequent tests showed that bromate levels were within permissible limits after an appeal. The FSSAI found that five other water samples from the facility complied with safety standards.

stories.title: 'Jensen! Jensen! Jensen!’: Nvidia employees chant Huang’s name as he makes stunning return as CEO | Watch
stories.summary: Nvidia employees celebrated Jensen Huang's return as CEO, chanting his name and distributing cupcakes bearing the message “Jensen is back.” However, his reinstatement comes amid questions over the board's handling of the crisis and ongoing investigations into allegations surrounding the chipmaker.

stories.title: GSK India enters blood cancer space with Blenrep launch, bets on new drugs for growth
stories.summary: The launch of its third oncology drug expands GSK’s innovative medicines portfolio as it targets doubling revenue to ₹8,000 crore by FY30, with new assets expected to contribute at least 20% to overall revenue.

stories.title: China, India set for record Russian oil imports in 2026, but demand seen peaking
stories.summary: China and India are set to achieve record imports of Russian oil due to supply gaps. This increase comes amid the ongoing Iran war and US sanctions waivers affecting oil purchases. Chinese imports have risen significantly, accounting for about a quarter of its total oil imports. India's imports also surged, with expectations that demand will stabilize as Middle Eastern supplies normalize.

stories.title: Before returning as CEO, Jensen Huang told Nvidia board of additional affairs beyond two reported | What we know
stories.summary: Nvidia has reinstated CEO Jensen Huang, 11 days after he stepped down amid revelations about his extramarital relationships. The decision followed intervention by Donald Trump, support from Elon Musk and other tech leaders, and assurances from the Justice Department.

stories.title: Lodha Developers sitting on inventory worth Rs 2 lakh cr, to invest less on land acquisition
stories.summary: Lodha Developers intends to reduce its land acquisition efforts due to an extensive inventory worth Rs 2 lakh crore. The company aims to generate free cash flow and decrease its net debt significantly in the coming years. It anticipates stronger housing demand among large companies, which has been evident in recent sales.

stories.title: India aluminium body urges stable policy, higher import duties ahead of annual budget
stories.summary: The Aluminium Association of India has requested government support ahead of the fiscal 2028 budget announcement. They proposed raising customs duties on primary aluminium and downstream products to curb rising imports. Key producers like Hindalco Industries and Vedanta are increasing investments in new capacity for future growth.

stories.title: Nvidia’s Huang to Face Bipartisan Scrutiny on Capitol Hill
stories.summary: Nvidia’s newly reinstated chief executive officer Jensen Huang is set to testify publicly before a Senate committee on Dec. 3. Huang will also speak behind closed doors for a transcribed interview by a trio of House committees on Dec. 1. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.title: US blacklists Alibaba subsidiary and Megaspeed linked to Nvidia scandal
Nvidia's Huang returns to cheers in China, but political hurdles mount on both sides
stories.summary: Jensen Huang has been reinstated as Nvidia CEO, reflecting his influence in US-China technology relations. His return comes amidst rising tensions, with the US tightening chip restrictions on China. Huang is set to face scrutiny from Congress regarding export controls shortly. Despite his popularity, the changing political landscape poses challenges for his role in bridging the two economies.
